_: Director pipeline switches. free_only (Sam, 22 Oct 2026 09:20: spend nothing): every model seat uses OpenRouter models whose id ends in ':free', any paid model is refused in code, and the sound stage uses free engines on the runner (voice: Chatterbox or Kokoro; music: the procedural score engine). Only Sam turns this off (set false here, or KF_FREE_ONLY=0 in the workflow env).

procedural.note: the free procedural score engine (films/lib/score/, Age of Empires and Anno feel). It scores a film that already has cues.json and audio/vo/line*.mp3, so sound.py first places the narration on the beat grid of a quiet pad made in code (pad.py; the pad also stands in as the score if the engine is missing or fails), runs the mix, then runs remix.py, which writes audio/score_plan.json, score.json and a new audio/mix.m4a.

free_seats._: Free models per role, best first (id prefixes or substrings, matched against the live ':free' list on the runner by films/director/free.py). text = writer, fact checker, crew; code = spec drafts and repairs; vision = eyes. Models not listed must clear min_params_b or min_iq and must not match exclude or known_bad. minimax-m3.1-flash:free is known good (the web studio's director chat runs on it). Live on 22 Oct 2026 15:30 UTC: only 14 free models (Google Gemma 4 26b and 31b, rate limited all the time; NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra 550b, Super 120b, 3.5 Super VL; small or agentic-only others). minimax-m3.1-flash:free was not in the list that day.
